# etqws3 block textures

Two pixel-art sheets by etqws3, released under CC0 1.0 (public domain
dedication) on OpenGameArt. Fetched 2026-11-13. Renamed on download; the
contents are unchanged.

| File here | Original name | Source | sha256 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `blocks-20-textures.png` (448 x 296) | `2015-02-17 [Blocks] (20 Textures)(9x2 Color Schemes).png` | https://opengameart.org/content/square-block-textures | `388f55d293474b0537b7aeabd9ab98399e8871495cd94c1c8094ef5928bf15a4` |
| `block-variations-study.png` (1296 x 728) | `2015-02-12 (Block Variations Study)1.png` | https://opengameart.org/content/16x16-square-block-variations | `6fdcf0e0b7374edf3922f11ade105f3a2f80da4d75d9d659fe6853562fd1e0e0` |

The first is 16 blocks of 16 x 16 and 4 of 8 x 8 pixels in 9 colour
schemes with 2 variations each; the second is 16 x 16 blocks with raised
and sunk surface features in 3 palettes (from the pages' descriptions).
